title: Benidorm Radial Coast Cross-City Network - Lines 012 and 054
notes: Coast cross-city discovery component for the Benidorm legacy scenario family.
Both routes use independently ordered official ida/vuelta patterns with closesLoop false.
Line 012 spans Altea, El Albir, Benidorm, Finestrat, Hospital Marina Baixa and La Vila Joiosa.
Line 054 links La Vila Joiosa, Hospital Marina Baixa, Cala de Finestrat, western Benidorm and the bus station.
Optional representation metadata. It is not authoritative simulation state.
Package identity moved into the Benidorm radial family; route, pattern, stop, coordinate and settlement data are otherwise unchanged.
